content.short: Onramper is a fiat-crypto onramp aggregator.
content.description: Onramper provides a fiat-to-crypto onramp aggregator that lets end users buy or sell cryptocurrency through an embedded, secure, and seamless experience powered by a single integration. The platform is used by leading exchanges, wallets, DeFi protocols, and other Web3 projects to offer KYC-compliant crypto purchases and sales directly within their apps. Based in Amsterdam and founded in 2020, Onramper has raised about $6 million in funding and supports more than 16 payment methods across 180+ countries.
